sources.title: Factory Raises $150M: Model-Agnostic AI Coding Agents
sources.snippet: Cost optimization becomes practical—switch models per task based on complexity and volume. The AI coding tools market is heading toward consolidation. GitHub, Cursor, and Factory compete for enterprise share. Factory's $150 million war chest funds the race to prove model-agnostic, full-SDLC automation beats single-vendor depth.

sources.title: Dragon - 企业级中转 - Dragon Code
sources.snippet: 更低的价格，更简单的配置，让每位开发者都能用上顶级 AI 编码模型。 一个 DragonCode 账号，同时使用 Claude Code 和 Codex。 统一的 API 接入与网络环境，把时间还给你的代码，而不是配置面板。 统一的域名与密钥格式，覆盖常见IDE 插件与CLI工具。 一键配置环境。

sources.title: GitHub - naoum40/Dragon-Code
sources.snippet: 💡 About the project Dragon Code is an open-source application inspired by OpenAI's Codex. It allows you to code with AI assistance, specifically configured to use the free Nvidia NIM models.
